scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:frontend
scripts.build:data: echo 'No build needed for data/client (TypeScript library)'
scripts.build:server: echo 'No build needed for server (Bun runtime)'
scripts.build:metadata: echo 'No build needed for book-metadata (TypeScript library)'
scripts.clean: bun run clean:data && bun run clean:server && bun run clean:frontend && bun run clean:cli && bun run clean:metadata
scripts.test: bun run lint && bun test --cwd data/client && bun test --cwd server && bun test --cwd cli && bun run test:frontend
scripts.test:unit: bun test --cwd data/client && bun test --cwd server && bun test --cwd cli && bun run test:frontend
scripts.test:all: bun run test:data && bun run test:server && bun run test:cli && bun run test:metadata && bun run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:coverage:generate && bun run test:coverage:report
scripts.test:coverage:generate: bun run test:coverage:clean && bun run test:coverage:workspaces && bun run test:coverage:root && bun run test:coverage:merge
scripts.test:coverage:workspaces: bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --cwd data/client && bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --cwd cli && bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --cwd services/book-metadata
scripts.test:coverage:clean: rm -rf coverage data/client/coverage server/coverage cli/coverage services/book-metadata/coverage
scripts.coverage:view: bun run test:coverage:generate && bun run test:coverage:report && open coverage/index.html
scripts.devtools: concurrently "bun run devtools:watch" "bun run devtools:ui:dev" "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.devtools:ui:serve: bun run devtools:ui:build && bun run devtools/ui/server.ts
